name: Miami residential (lowest priority)
comment: 1000 m x 1000 m cells around named public anchors; centres written by `regionkit.sh anchors`.

zones.templateReason: Nearest warm-climate vocabulary: stucco walls, low hipped/gabled ranches, a flat-roof modern family and a terracotta roof colour slot. Not a desert, so its tree priors (and gravel yards in the proposal) are wrong for Miami and must be reviewed.

barrel-tile roof identity (only colour; no tile eave/ridge geometry)
low-rise condo / balcony bands (role block always takes the first flat-roof type)
